notes: Axes: factual correctness, executable pointers, calibrated evidence.

The eight ledger rate rows are 4 in section 1, 2 in ER-2, 1 in the round-16 append, and 1 in the round-18 append. Round 52 adds a drift-pins cell-supersession paragraph, not a ninth rate-table row.

No tools installed or updated. Initial exploratory sectionizer invocation passed str and failed; corrected to the frozen API-required raw bytes. Two exploratory row selectors over/under-counted non-rate tables; final section-scoped substantive-row sweep records 4+2+1+1.
Scratch deleted before terminal yield; no lane source files edited.
